build_vlm_causal_lm: build a vision language model server using VlmCausalLM to process image and text inputs for generation
create_vlm_batch: create a VlmCausalLMBatch from protobuf requests with image inputs and tokenized text using from_pb_processor
encode_images_vlm: encode images in a VlmCausalLMBatch by extracting pixel values and computing vision embeddings via encode_images
replace_image_tokens: replace image placeholders with model-specific token strings using image_text_replacement for idefics, llava, qwen2, or llama4
calculate_image_grid: calculate the any-resolution image grid shape for patch-based vision models using get_anyres_image_grid_shape
